questions.q: Hepatocytes take up glucose through which insulin-independent transporter?
questions.explain: Hepatocytes use GLUT2, which is insulin-independent; insulin acts downstream to drive glycogen synthesis, while GLUT4 is insulin-stimulated in muscle and fat.

questions.q: Glucagon raises blood glucose mainly by triggering which process in this organ?
questions.explain: Glucagon opposes insulin, causing the liver to convert stored glycogen into glucose.
